Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
> Archon
> Cardtype: Political Action
> Requires a prince or justicar.
> Choose a Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire. This vampire may enter combat with a vampire controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth  action. Any vampire attempting to block this vampire burns 1 blood. Blood hunts cannot be called on this vampire. Any Camarilla vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
>
> Vlad Tepes
> Clan: Tzimisce
> Group: 3
> Capacity: 10
> Discipline: aus ANI DOM PRO THA VIC
> Independent: Vlad can play and use cards requiring a title or a sect as if he had that title or were of that sect. +1 bleed.
>
Can Vald Tepes choose himself as a target of an Archon vote he calls?

I guess the answer is YES because of the following ruling, but I would like to be sure.

> When playing a card requiring a title or a sect, he is treated as a such for all effects of the card, including duration effects. [ANK 20190228] [LSJ 20101013]
>
Thanks in advance!

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de
